title: IFX I2 program: P10.GATE successor for V4 Guards 1.1.6 + ifx_profile 0.4.4 (IFX-V4-001)
goal: Reach P10.GATE for the I1 tuple through phased, separately authorized Plans: installed Web UI record, CI evidence redesign with a new bundle, V3 promotion to main without bypass, curated adoption package, workflow installation with negative tests, ruleset aggregate and coexistence window.
acceptanceCriteria: Every phase I2-A to I2-G has its own exact Plan and authorization before execution.
No remote write, ruleset change or default-branch change happens without explicit per-step operator approval.
P10.GATE is recorded only when all conditions of plan 06 section 8 hold.
risks: CI Post cannot run with lock-pinned bundle 0.4.4 (F1).
A normal PR to main cannot pass the V3 trusted-base checks (F2).
Remote setting changes could be taken as implied by program approval.
decisions: 1A: switch the default branch to codex/guards-principles-plan, fast-forward main, switch back.
2B: curated docs/guards/v4-adoption package; only v4-adoption is admitted to the V3 allowlist.
